title: Practice 5: при, на поезде, в этом году

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: I like reading by daylight.
exercises.why: «при» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Алексей Н. Толстой, «Хождение по мукам»*
exercises.ru: Отряд на ___, с пулеметными тачанками, двинулся из села.
exercises.why: «на» + prepositional for how you travel: на поезде, на машине. From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Хождение по мукам».

exercises.q: Girls are more ambitious academically than boys.
exercises.ru: Девочки в ___ более амбициозны, чем мальчики.

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Антон Чехов, «Зелёная коса»*

exercises.q: Более тысячи человек погибло при ___ (обрушение) текстильной фабрики в Бангладеш.
exercises.prompt: More than a 1000 workers died when a textile factory collapsed in Bangladesh.
exercises.why: «при» + prepositional. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
